AP Calculus AB Practice Exam
Section II, Part A — Calculator Required — 30 minutes
Free Response

1. Let f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 9x + 1. (9 points)
(a) Find f'(x). (2 points)
(b) Find all x-values where f has a relative maximum. Justify your answer. (3 points)
(c) Find the absolute minimum value of f on the closed interval [0, 4]. (4 points)

2. A particle moves along the x-axis with velocity v(t) = 2t - 4 for t >= 0.
(a) At what time is the particle at rest? (1 point)
(b) Is the particle speeding up or slowing down at t = 1? Explain. (2 points)
(c) Find the total distance traveled from t = 0 to t = 3. (3 points)

Scoring Guidelines
1. (a) 3x^2 - 12x + 9 (b) x = 1 (c) 1
2. (a) 2 (b) Rubric: speeding up; v and a have same sign (c) 5
